plugin.appview.open.description: The surface asks the application sidecar to start the program of its settings.

plugin.appview.input.description: The surface sends one input message of the embed protocol to the application; only its type is stored.

plugin.appview.message.description: The application sidecar sent a message to the surface; event is its event name, or error.

plugin.appview.error.description: The surface reports an error of the application, the sidecar, the host or its settings.
